# ferriskey_authz_builtin_schema (Data Source)

Reads the built-in `FerrisKey` Cedar schema (users, groups, roles, organizations, agents and MCP tools) that every realm schema is merged with. Useful to reference its types when writing a `ferriskey_authz_schema`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ferriskey_authz_builtin_schema" "main" {
  realm = "acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String) Realm to query.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier (equal to `realm`).
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the built-in schema (`FerrisKey`).
- `source` (String) Cedar text of the built-in schema.
